overview_description.description: Simbie AI develops AI voice agents that act as virtual medical staff for healthcare practices. Its platform handles inbound and outbound patient calls, registration, scheduling, refill requests, and pre-visit intake while integrating directly with EMR and EHR systems. The system also supports medication reconciliation, prior-authorization workflows, and automated chart documentation from patient interactions. Simbie AI is designed for independent and multi-site medical practices that want to reduce administrative workload, standardize front-desk operations, and maintain continuous patient access. The company offers healthcare-specific workflows, including triage-focused intake, perioperative coordination, and follow-up outreach to keep patients connected between visits.

about_short_description.short_description: Simbie AI provides AI voice agents that automate patient calls, scheduling, intake, and clinical documentation for healthcare practices.

product.name: Simbie Inbound & Outbound Voice Agents
product.description: AI voice agents that handle inbound and outbound patient calls for scheduling, refills, intake, and routine questions.

product.name: Virtual Post-Discharge Care Platform
product.description: A platform providing virtual follow-up care within three days after hospital discharge to support patient transitions and reduce readmissions.

product.name: EMR/EHR Integration Agent
product.description: AI agent that connects to EHR systems to monitor tasks, reconcile medications, and execute administrative workflows.

product.name: Care Coordination and Patient Navigation
product.description: A service where navigators maintain continuous contact with patients to manage follow-up schedules, reschedule appointments, and assist with transportation and resource connections.

product.name: Chart Documentation Tool
product.description: Tool that converts information from patient calls into structured clinical documentation in the EHR.

identifier.value: Interim Virtual Primary Care Provider (PCP) Service

product.name: Interim Virtual Primary Care Provider (PCP) Service
product.description: A service providing patients without a permanent PCP with a temporary virtual primary care provider to bridge care gaps after hospital discharge.
